Sub:  
Transcript of the Earnings Conference Call on the Consolidated and Standalone Unaudited 
Financial Results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 
 
We wish to inform you that the Transcript of the Earnings Conference Call held on July 18, 2026 at  
3:00 p.m. (IST) in connection with the Consolidated and Standalone Unaudited Financial Results of the 
Bank for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, is made available on the website of the Bank and can be accessed 
on the following link:  
 
https://www.kotak.bank.in/en/investor-relations/financial-results.html  
 
We request you to take the above on record and disseminate the same on your website. 
 
Thanking you, 
 
Yours faithfully, 
For Kotak Mahindra Bank Limited
